estimated_roles.why: Retail expansion — 'moving beyond the D2C site into physical presence' — is one of the three stated uses of the Rs 10 Cr, and a first store or experience centre in Mumbai needs floor staff before it needs anything else. High likelihood the role opens; low value for an engineering graduate specifically, who would be overqualified and would find it a poor bridge into a business-track career. Fixed cash sits at the bottom of the band with a commission on ticket value on top.

estimated_roles.title: Founder's Office / Business Associate
estimated_roles.family: Founder's office / chief of staff / strategy associate
estimated_roles.why: Five founders, a strategic and celebrity cap table including BEENEXT, an international expansion plan and roughly 10-30 people means a lot of unowned work — investor reporting, market entry research for the US and Gulf, vendor and retail-site diligence, pricing models. At this size the seat usually exists in substance before it exists as a title, which is why this is 'possible' rather than 'likely'. Note the benchmark treats this band as bimodal and this company sits firmly in its bottom cluster.

companies.fit_reason: The door is genuinely open — every role Ekatra has posted is junior, three of the five are explicitly pitched at fresher level, and a company hiring ~11 people onto a ~10-30 person base will take graduates because it cannot afford anyone else. A numerate B.E. graduate has a real edge in three of these seats: performance marketing (ROAS, CAC, cohort and contribution-margin math), e-commerce catalogue and merchandising across a 5,000+ design library, and fulfilment operations on a vertically integrated chain with IGI certification, hallmarking, insured logistics and US/Middle East export documentation. That last one is closer to an industrial-engineering problem than most people expect. Against that: there is no engineering organisation here at all and no prospect of one, so the degree is credential-only; the money is Rs 3-6.5L for most of these roles, at or below the median Indian fresher offer; a six-month-old brand with no HR function offers no structured training, no rotation and no graduate programme, so the learning is entirely self-directed and the manager is likely a founder; equity is effectively nil; and one of the likeliest openings is a shop-floor client-advisor job that a B.E. graduate would be overqualified for and that rarely converts into a business-track career. This is a good first job for someone who specifically wants D2C consumer-brand operating experience in Mumbai and is willing to trade pay and stability for scope. For anyone else it is a poor risk-adjusted choice.
companies.caveat: Four things could make this wrong. First, the role list is the weak link: it comes from a single LinkedIn hiring post roughly a month old, and one retrieval of the jobs page flagged it as past/archived with nothing confirmed live — so "listed now" means "was posted verbatim", not "open today", and anyone acting on this should email info@ekatrajewels.com before treating any title as real. Second, no benchmark row in the file has a jewellery, luxury or physical-retail cut; every row I used is built from tech-startup and e-commerce salary data, and luxury retail conventionally pays client-facing staff less fixed and more variable than these bands imply, so the split between my band and an actual offer could be structural rather than a level difference. Third, no Ekatra salary has ever been reported to any aggregator, headcount is a self-reported LinkedIn 2-10 band, and the cap table is celebrity/strategic (Ekta Kapoor, Sussanne Khan, Sanjay Kapoor) rather than institutional — that register can support either an above-band brand-building splurge or a deliberately thin cash payroll, and I cannot tell which from outside. Fourth, the company is six months old with a Rs 10 Cr round; a single retail-expansion decision could double or halt this entire hiring plan before any of these roles reach a graduate.

estimated_roles.title: Sales Engineer / Business Development Executive — STP & ETP
estimated_roles.family: Business development, inside sales and account management
estimated_roles.why: The round is explicitly for first commercial deployments in Delhi NCR over ~12 months. A productised STP sold to builders, hotels, factories, pharma and campuses is a field-sold capital purchase — the first non-founder business hire in this industry is almost always a sales engineer who can walk a site, read a flow diagram and qualify a plant sizing. A B.Tech in chemical, environmental, mechanical or civil is the standard profile, which is exactly the candidate in question.

estimated_roles.title: Proposals & Estimation Executive (pre-sales / tendering)
estimated_roles.family: Business development, inside sales and account management
estimated_roles.why: Every STP/ETP/ZLD enquiry turns into a sized techno-commercial offer, a BOQ and often a tender bid for a builder or a government-adjacent campus. Founders cannot keep writing those once enquiry volume starts. This is the classic fresher entry seat in Indian water-treatment companies and it is business-track, not design-track.

estimated_roles.title: Service & AMC Coordinator (O&M and spares)
estimated_roles.family: Operations, supply chain and city launch
estimated_roles.why: The round funds standing up a service and spare-parts network, and AMC/O&M contracts are a stated revenue line, not an afterthought. Once the first plants are commissioned somebody has to schedule visits, chase consumables and chemicals, log compliance readings for DPCC/CPCB reporting and keep clients from escalating to the founders. Coordination-heavy, low technical bar, natural fresher seat — but only after the first few plants are actually running.

estimated_roles.title: Founder's Office / Business Associate
estimated_roles.family: Founder's office / chief of staff / strategy associate
estimated_roles.why: A two-director company standing up a factory, a product and a first sales motion at once is the textbook case for one generalist who does market mapping, RFQ chasing, vendor calls and investor-reporting decks. Real possibility, but at this size founders often just do it themselves for another year, so this is not a safe bet.

estimated_roles.title: Procurement & Vendor Coordination Executive
estimated_roles.family: Operations, supply chain and city launch
estimated_roles.why: Point (1) of what the round funds is setting up a manufacturing facility for factory-built plants. Modular manufacturing means sourcing pumps, blowers, membranes, MBBR media, panels and fabrication against a repeating BOM — that is a purchase/vendor-follow-up desk long before it is a supply-chain function. Would open only once the facility is real.

companies.fit_reason: Genuinely two-sided. In favour: the Indian water and wastewater treatment industry is one of the few sectors that routinely hires fresh B.Tech graduates straight into commercial seats — sales engineer, proposals and estimation, service coordination — because the product needs someone who can read a P&ID and size a plant, and a chemical, environmental, mechanical or civil graduate from 2026/2027 is precisely that candidate. A 5-person company also gives a fresher exposure to the whole cycle, from enquiry to commissioning to AMC, that a large EPC firm would not. Against, and this is the part that keeps it out of "good": there is no careers page, no LinkedIn job, no HR function and no evidence of any hiring at all — the empty currently_open list is real, not a research gap. The first two or three hires at a company like this are far more likely to be an experienced process-design engineer and a proven NCR sales person with an existing builder and consultant network than a fresher, because a pre-seed team cannot afford to train. Realistically, treat this as a company to watch and approach directly rather than one to plan around. There is no campus process, no structured programme and no guarantee it hires anyone this financial year. Pay will be below what a peer of yours gets at a funded software startup, and the honest offset is ownership and hands-on scope, not cash.
companies.careers_url: None exists. https://neuromodaqua.com/careers/ returns HTTP 404, the full page sitemap (https://neuromodaqua.com/page-sitemap1.xml) has 12 pages and none is a careers page, and https://www.linkedin.com/company/neuromod-aqua lists no jobs. The only application route is a direct approach: https://neuromodaqua.com/contact/ or email sales@neuromodaqua.com / cto@neuromodaqua.com, addressed to the founders (Anuj Arora, Anand Dad).
companies.caveat:
The honest reason this could be wrong: every role here is predicted, none is observed. The company has published zero job listings, so the role list is inferred from what the round is stated to fund and from how comparable Indian water-treatment businesses staff up — if the founders instead spend the next year on product validation and the factory with no commercial hires at all, the correct answer for a 2026/2027 graduate is that there is nothing here, and that outcome is entirely plausible for a three-month-old company with Rs 1 lakh paid-up capital and an undisclosed round.

Three more specific failure modes. First, the round size is undisclosed. Pre-seed from one angel could be Rs 50 lakh or Rs 5 crore, and those imply very different pay envelopes; I banded for the small end, so if the cheque was large every number here is 20-30% low. Second, the sector haircut is my judgment, not a benchmark row — the file has no water, cleantech or industrial-equipment family, so I mapped a hardware EPC business onto rows built from software-startup postings and cut them. A reader who thinks a VC-backed "productised STP" company will pay like a tech startup would land closer to Rs 4.5-7L for the sales seat. Third, small industrial firms in Delhi NCR often hire freshers as six-month unpaid or stipendiary trainees (Rs 10,000-20,000/month) before confirming a CTC at all, which would put a real first-year number below the bottom of every band above.

Band confidence is set to low deliberately: the strongest underlying row was only medium, and all three lowering conditions in the rules apply at once — the company is very small (2-5 people), the stage label is contested (export says Seed, all coverage says pre-seed), and the profile is unverified because no careers page or listing exists to check against. Any headcount or hiring statement about a company this new will also go stale within a quarter.

estimated_roles.family: Operations, supply chain and city launch

An Operations Head at Rs 12 LPA+ has just been posted in Gurugram and will need executive-level support beneath him. This is the single most likely fresher entry point at the company and the most natural fit for a mechanical, industrial or production engineering graduate.

estimated_roles.title: Depot / Warehouse Executive (new-city launch)
estimated_roles.family: Operations, supply chain and city launch
estimated_roles.why: Geographic expansion across India - more warehouses and customer touchpoints beyond the current eight depots and 100+ touchpoints - is the first stated use of the round. Every new depot needs a junior on-site executive before it needs a manager. Banded against the non-metro row because these sit in manufacturing clusters (Pune, Chennai, Haridwar, Bahadrabad, Hosur-type locations), not at the Gurugram HQ, which is a real Rs 1-2 LPA cut versus the same job in NCR.

estimated_roles.title: Key Account Executive / Customer Success Associate
estimated_roles.family: Business development, inside sales and account management
estimated_roles.why: Pooling is a subscription-shaped business with 30+ enterprise customers already on the books, and revenue depends on assets coming back rather than on new logos alone. Someone junior has to sit between the customer's plant team and Yantra's depots on cycle counts, lost-asset disputes, billing reconciliation and volume ramps. Retention economics at this stage make this a defensible early hire, though it is often merged into the ops executive seat at a company this small - which is why it pays at the bottom of the BD row rather than the top.

estimated_roles.title: Supply Chain Analyst - Trakkia / Asset Visibility
estimated_roles.family: Business analyst and data analyst
estimated_roles.why: Strengthening the technology stack behind Trakkia - asset tracking, IoT/RFID, supply-chain visibility - is a named use of the round, and they are already hiring a Business Intelligence/Tableau Developer. The business-side companion to that is an analyst who turns scan and RFID data into utilisation, dwell-time and loss-rate reporting for customers and for the asset-purchase decision. Banded well below the family ceiling because Rs 11 LPA at seed buys an ex-consulting or premium-campus founder's-office analyst, which is not what a 20-person asset-heavy logistics company hires.

estimated_roles.title: Founder's Office / Business Associate
estimated_roles.family: Founder's office / chief of staff / strategy associate
estimated_roles.why: Two founders (Vipin Battu and Karan Saharan) who have just closed an institutional seed and are opening new cities typically add one generalist to handle investor reporting, new-city feasibility, pricing models and vendor diligence. Marked possible rather than likely: asset-heavy operating companies fill this need with an ops or finance hire far more often than with a named founder's-office seat, and at 17-30 people the budget for a pure generalist competes directly with a depot lease.

companies.fit_reason: Mixed, and the two halves pull hard in opposite directions. Against: not one of the five currently-open roles is a fresher role. Operations Head, Manager - B2B Enterprise Sales (4-6 yrs), Purchase Executive (2-4 yrs) and Warehouse Manager Pune (2-5 yrs) all demand experience, there is no careers page, no campus programme, and no management-trainee track - at 17-30 people on the core payroll, every hire has to be productive in week one, and a company that has just raised for asset purchases rather than headcount has little slack to train anyone. The only open role a 0-1 year candidate clears outright is the Bahadrabad Warehouse Supervisor at Rs 1.8-3.6 LPA, which is a shift-floor job in a small Uttarakhand town, not a business-track launchpad. For: the underlying work is unusually well matched to a mechanical, industrial, production or civil graduate in a way that a fintech or SaaS seed never is. Pooling operations is physical-flow problem solving - cycle time, dwell time, asset recovery rates, wash-line throughput, reverse-logistics routing - and B.Tech grads with no MBA are the standard hire for it across Indian logistics and 3PL companies. An eight-depot network expanding on fresh capital creates junior ops and depot seats faster than it creates senior ones, and joining a 20-person company at seed means real scope within a year. The honest read: apply for the ops and depot track and expect Rs 3.5-6 LPA in Gurugram or Rs 2.5-4.5 LPA at a cluster site, treat enterprise sales and founder's office as long shots until they post them, and be aware that nothing on their board today is aimed at you.
companies.caveat: The honest reason this could be wrong is that six of the eight roles are inferred from what the round funds, not observed anywhere - and this company has given no signal at all that it hires freshers into business roles. Every posting it has made asks for 2-6 years. If Yantra Packs simply keeps hiring experienced operators, as most 20-person asset-heavy companies do, the correct answer is closer to "poor fit, one warehouse job" than to the eight-role list above. Specific weaknesses: (a) yantrapacks.com has no careers section - /careers and /career both 404, there is no sitemap - so the role list is a best-effort union scraped across LinkedIn, Naukri, Glassdoor and Indeed, and the Purchase Executive and Pune Warehouse Manager entries come from search-result summaries rather than pages anyone opened, since Naukri and Glassdoor both returned 403; the Pune listing dates to June 2026 and may well be filled. (b) The benchmark rows carrying most of the weight here are the weakest in the file - the ops/supply-chain seed rows and the business-analyst seed rows are all marked low confidence and are explicitly described by their own notes as triangulated or extrapolated rather than measured, because no Indian salary aggregator tags employers by funding stage. (c) Rs 12 Cr goes much less far here than at a software seed: the capital is earmarked for containers, warehouses and the Trakkia stack, so the headcount plan behind this round may be a handful of hires rather than the dozen this list implies, and the ones that happen may skew senior. (d) Band confidence is set to low, one step below what the source rows would otherwise support, because a 17-person payroll is small enough that any single founder's preference moves an offer more than the market does. (e) Watch the name when searching: the legal entity is Yantraksh Logistics Private Limited and most boards file it that way, while "Yantra" plus recruitment overwhelmingly returns Yantra India Limited, the Ministry of Defence ammunition PSU with thousands of apprentice vacancies - a completely unrelated employer.

Engineering graduates are commonly hired into this seat for the analytics side.

estimated_roles.why: The round also funds AI-led products built on Lissun's proprietary clinical data, and a 25-centre network generates utilisation, therapist-productivity, no-show and outcome data that nobody is currently reporting cleanly. estimated_roles.family: Founder's office / chief of staff / strategy associate
estimated_roles.why: Standard post-Series-A hire at a company with a small corporate core and a network-expansion mandate: new-city site selection, investor reporting, the Being Cares (US) integration, and whatever the founders are not able to cover. Highest-paying business-track entry seat here, and the hardest to get — usually one hire, often from a premium campus.

companies.fit_reason:
Nothing currently open is available to an engineering graduate. All five live roles in the profile — Speech Language Pathologist (Noida), Speech Language Pathologist (Delhi), Speech Language Pathologist (Pune District), Occupational Therapist (Greater Bengaluru Area), Occupational Therapist (Pune District) — are licensed clinical jobs requiring a BASLP/MASLP or BOT/MOT degree and RCI registration. That is why no role below is marked "listed now": tagging a clinical vacancy as a fresher business opening would be false. It is also a signal, not an accident — the round funds clinical capacity, so clinical hiring is what shows up first.

What makes the fit "mixed" rather than "poor" is that a 25-centre network plus a D2C funnel plus a corporate EAP line structurally requires non-clinical staff, and Lissun is adding centres fast. Those seats exist and turn over. But be clear about what they are: centre operations and therapy-enquiry conversion are the two lanes with real volume, they pay ₹3-6.5 LPA, and they are administrative and phone-heavy — an engineering degree buys you nothing in them beyond being organised with a spreadsheet. The seats that would actually use an engineering graduate's training — the analyst role and the founder's-office role, ₹6-11 LPA — probably amount to one or two openings a year at a company with a corporate core of a few dozen people, and they compete against MBA and premium-campus applicants.

Worth knowing: Lissun runs no careers page at all (lissun.app/careers 404s), so every one of these roles surfaces only on LinkedIn. Set an alert on the company page rather than checking a site.
companies.caveat:
These are estimates built from benchmark rows, not published bands — Lissun has never disclosed compensation, and no role below was priced from an actual Lissun offer or posting.

Confidence is set to low, one step down from the "medium" carried by most of the Series A-B tier-1 rows I used, for two compounding reasons: the corporate core paying these salaries is small (roughly 20-40 non-clinical people beneath a ₹48 Cr round), and every underlying row is built from SaaS, quick-commerce and consumer-tech comparables rather than health-services clinic networks, so all six bands rest on a judgement-call discount rather than on observed healthcare data. The centre-operations and client-relationship bands in particular are the two I would most expect a real offer to come in below — India clinic-admin and health telecalling pay can start near ₹2.5 LPA, under the floors quoted here.

Six roles are listed but they are not six parallel opportunities. Realistically two lanes hire with any regularity (centre ops, enquiry conversion), and the four marked "possible" may amount to a single opening each, or none in a given year.

Two facts from the profile carry over as caveats. First, one source (pharmabiz) places the HQ in Bengaluru against LinkedIn and the registered office in Sector 67, Gurgaon — I priced Gurugram, but both are tier-1 in this benchmark's city split, so the bands do not move either way. Second, the five live roles came from LinkedIn's guest job feed, which under-reports; five is a floor, and an unlisted business-track opening may well exist that this analysis could not see.

companies.fit_reason:
Mixed, leaning weak on pay and decent on access. The access side is genuinely good: the live Keka feed is dominated by 0-3 year roles and internships, there are at least eight business-track titles a 0-1 year graduate could actually be hired into today, and a fresh Rs 192Cr round explicitly funds retail expansion into four new cities plus a production ramp - both of which generate repeat entry-level sales, supply-chain and support openings over the next 12-18 months. The internship pipeline (Logistics and Supply Chain Intern, Events Management, Service Packing) is a real conversion path, which is how most small hardware companies fill these seats.

The weak side is what the roles are and what they pay. The business track here is overwhelmingly showroom sales, after-sales inventory and customer support - field and branch-operations work priced at Rs 2.4-5.0 LPA, which is roughly half to a third of what the same 2026/2027 engineering graduate would get from an IT services or product company. The higher-quality analytical business seats (product, category, strategy, growth analytics) essentially do not exist at ~104-250 people; Founder's Office and MIS Analyst are predictions, not listings, and may never open. The two best-paying listed business roles, Procurement Executive/Buyer and Content Strategist, both realistically target 2-4 year candidates. And an engineering graduate applying here is a stronger candidate for the technical roles (EV Assembly Associate is shop floor, but design, battery and vehicle-engineering roles turn over at a company this stage) than for the business ones. Worth applying if the pull is EV hardware and Chennai; not worth it if the goal is a paid, structured business-side graduate programme, because Raptee.HV does not run one.
companies.careers_url: https://www.rapteehv.com/careers/ (live listings served from https://raptee.keka.com/careers; the Workable page at apply.workable.com/raptee-energy is stale and effectively empty)
companies.caveat: Every number here is an estimate derived from benchmark rows, not a published band - Raptee.HV has never disclosed compensation, and none of these titles carries a posted salary. Four specific weaknesses to hold in mind. (1) The round itself is not confirmed: the 18 Aug 2026 reporting describes a Series A being raised ($15-20M, roughly Rs 140-190Cr, "begun the process", hoped to close within three months), the todo entry lists zero investors, and the Rs 192Cr figure sits at or just above the top of the reported range - so the hiring expansion these predictions hang on may be slower or smaller than modelled. (2) Every benchmark row I used is tagged confidence "low" by its own author, and the notes say so bluntly ("weakest cell in the table", "extrapolated, not directly measured", "no source segments Series A-B employers by city"). Stacking a low-confidence row on a judgmental hardware/retail haircut means these bands are planning priors, not measurements - individual offers at this stage vary more than the band width. (3) Headcount is disputed: EPFO-linked filings show ~104 employees while Wellfound lists 201-500, and any query for "Raptee Energy" against a data provider may return a US-flagged entity with an inflated 345-employee count. I priced off the ~104 salaried floor, which pushes bands down; if the Wellfound figure is right, add roughly 10-15%. (4) The listing snapshot is from the profile research, and a Keka feed at a company this size turns over within weeks - confirm each "listed now" title is still open before relying on it. Separately, "Technical Escalation Engineer" was excluded as engineering-titled but is really aftersales support sitting in Operations; if casting a wide net, price it alongside Customer Care Executive at Rs 3.0-5.0 LPA.

estimated_roles.title: Supply Chain / Procurement Executive (Trainee)
estimated_roles.family: Operations, supply chain and city launch (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)
estimated_roles.why: Electronic component sourcing, BOM costing, vendor follow-up and shortage management is the single largest non-engineering function in any EMS/ESDM business, and it scales directly with the Rs 100 Cr Krishnagiri plant (7 acres at SIPCOT, planned 100,000 sq ft, ~500 jobs) and the new Yamaha/Mycronic SMT line. A contract manufacturer buys far more than it designs, so a plant ramp of this size cannot happen without adding buyers and expeditors.

estimated_roles.title: Production Planning & Control (PPC) / Materials Planning Executive
estimated_roles.family: Operations, supply chain and city launch (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)
estimated_roles.why: Krishnagiri went from 15,000 to 25,000 sq ft with a new SMT line and a 100,000 sq ft plant is planned. Multi-customer, multi-BOM SMT scheduling, line loading, kitting and WIP tracking is planner work, and mixed-model EMS plants staff it with fresh graduates under a plant manager. Ties directly to the capex the deal underwrites.

estimated_roles.title: MIS / Costing Analyst (Finance)
estimated_roles.family: Business analyst and data analyst (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)
estimated_roles.why: Once Jubilant Ingrevia holds 40%, Zettaone is an equity-method associate of a listed company and has to produce quarterly, audit-grade numbers on a listed reporting calendar — plus job costing and capex tracking for a two-site, two-tranche build-out. That creates a genuine entry-level MIS/cost-accounting seat in Bengaluru that a small private EMS would not otherwise carry.

estimated_roles.title: Inside Sales & Customer Program Coordinator (RFQ / Quotations)
estimated_roles.family: Business development, inside sales and account management (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)
estimated_roles.why: EMS revenue is won by turning customer BOMs into quotes and then shepherding NPI builds. With a US arm in Fremont and OEM/ODM customers in semiconductor, automotive, telecom, avionics and medical, someone has to run RFQ intake, costing sheets, samples and customer status decks under the program managers. This is the most plausible customer-facing fresher door at the Bengaluru design centre.

estimated_roles.title: Quality Systems & Document Control Executive (QMS)
estimated_roles.family: Management trainee and graduate leadership programmes (India, 0-2 years) — business-side/non-engineering entry-level
estimated_roles.why: Serving automotive, avionics, defence and medical customers means IATF 16949 / AS9100 / ISO 13485-style regimes, and a listed parent raises the audit bar again. The documentation, traceability, ECN control and audit-pack half of quality (as distinct from test engineering) is routinely staffed with fresh graduates, and a new plant needs a full document set from day one.

estimated_roles.title: HR & Talent Acquisition Executive (Plant)
estimated_roles.family: Management trainee and graduate leadership programmes (India, 0-2 years) — business-side/non-engineering entry-level
estimated_roles.why: The announced Krishnagiri expansion is projected to add ~500 jobs on top of an existing ~500-person base. Doubling headcount in a plant town means volume blue-collar and technician hiring, contractor management, statutory compliance and onboarding — work that small manufacturers hire graduate HR executives for. Demand is real but the team will stay small, so expect one or two seats, not a cohort.

companies.fit_reason: Real openings will exist, but almost none of them are the business roles a 2026/27 engineering graduate is usually hunting for, and the pay is manufacturing pay, not startup pay. The upside: a Rs 100 Cr plant on 7 acres at SIPCOT Krishnagiri, a projected ~500 additional jobs, a new SMT line, and a listed 40% shareholder arriving from November 2026 together create genuine, datable demand for buyers, planners, quality documentation staff, plant HR and one or two finance/MIS seats. Those are the six roles above, and a B.E./B.Tech graduate is a credible candidate for the supply chain, PPC and quality-documentation ones because they need someone who can read a BOM and a drawing. The downside is threefold. First, an ESDM company's ~500 staff are described as overwhelmingly engineering and manufacturing — the natural fresher door here is a design, test or process engineering role, and the business-side org is thin by construction. Second, there is no product, growth, category or strategy function to enter: no consumer app, no marketplace, no founder's-office cohort, so the product-analyst, performance-marketing and category rows in the benchmark file simply do not apply to this employer. Third, the money is low by graduate expectation standards — most of these seats land Rs 3-6 LPA in a plant town, against the Naukri JobSpeak finding that 73% of Indian undergraduates expect above Rs 5 LPA while only 40% get it. On the live evidence, the official careers page carries exactly one opening, "Electrical Engineer I" in Fremont, CA, an engineering role in the US written for US work authorisation without sponsorship — it is not an India business-track vacancy, so I have not priced it in an India LPA band and there is currently no listed-now India business role to report. Verdict: worth watching from late 2026 as the plant staffs up, best approached through supply chain or planning, and not a place to expect a business-analyst or APM-shaped first job.
companies.caveat: These are benchmark-derived estimates. Zettaone has published no salary band, and neither has any comparable Indian EMS of this size; every figure above is inferred from the benchmark rows named in band_basis and adjusted by judgement. Five specific reasons to hold them loosely. (1) The export mislabels the event: "Series B, 190Cr, 2026-08-18" is in fact Jubilant Ingrevia acquiring a 40% stake for Rs 189.2 Cr, staged in two tranches with first closing expected around November 2026 and the second by September 2027 — so the hiring lift is spread over two years, not immediate, and none of these roles should be expected to open all at once. The export's empty "parent" field should effectively read Jubilant Ingrevia. (2) No benchmark row matches a profitable private manufacturing SME becoming a listed company's associate; I mapped it onto "listed/large" and discounted, which is a defensible choice but a choice, and it is the main reason band_confidence is low rather than medium. (3) The vacancy picture is incomplete. The official careers page shows one US engineering role and reads like an immigration-compliance advertisement, which strongly suggests it is not the live India requisition board; Naukri showed 3 Zettaone India openings and Glassdoor 1, but both blocked automated fetching with 403s. So "no India business roles" is true of the company website only — check Naukri, LinkedIn and the Krishnagiri/Hosur local job boards before concluding anything. (4) It is not stated anywhere how much of the Rs 189.2 Cr is primary capital reaching Zettaone versus secondary paid to existing shareholders; if it is largely secondary, the hiring ramp will be funded by the separately announced Rs 100 Cr plant capex and by operating cash, and will be slower than the headline number implies. (5) Two-site pay differs sharply within the same company: a Bengaluru Electronic City desk and a Krishnagiri SIPCOT plant seat at the same grade can differ by Rs 1-2 LPA, and the bands above already assume plant location for the ops, quality and HR roles. Also note the "founded 2007" date is the brand's start as a PCB engineering services firm; the Indian entity was incorporated 10 July 2014.

estimated_roles.title: Loan Officers - Gold Branches (Across AP, Telangana, Karnataka & Odisha)
estimated_roles.family: Field sales / business development
estimated_roles.why: The core hiring engine for the round. ₹230 Cr of growth equity is explicitly to take AUM from ₹4,024 Cr to ₹7,000 Cr by March 2027 via gold-branch rollout — 171 branches were already work-in-progress on top of 335 live. Each new gold branch needs 3-6 loan officers to source walk-in gold pledges, so this is a several-hundred-seat requisition and the single most fresher-accessible role in the company.

estimated_roles.title: Operations Executive – Gold Branches (Across AP, Telangana, Karnataka & Odisha)
estimated_roles.family: Branch operations
estimated_roles.why: The other half of the branch-opening unit: KYC and documentation, gold appraisal support, cash and vault handling, disbursement and release entries in the LMS. Every one of the 171 WIP branches needs at least one, and it is the standard entry rung into an NBFC branch. Trains on the job; no prior finance experience assumed.

estimated_roles.title: Cluster Internal Auditors - Gold Branches (Across AP, Telangana, Karnataka & Odisha)
estimated_roles.family: Risk and internal audit
estimated_roles.why: A gold-loan book scaling 75% in a year across four states is a physical-custody fraud risk, and ICRA's rationale plus the new institutional investor both push audit coverage. The job is branch-hopping surprise audits — gold-packet weight and purity verification, cash counts, KYC file checks. NBFCs do take freshers into this cadre, but B.Com/CA-inter profiles are preferred over engineers.

estimated_roles.title: MIS / Business Analyst – Head Office, Financial District, Hyderabad
estimated_roles.family: Business analyst / MIS
estimated_roles.why: First outside institutional shareholder (Neo Wealth, ~10%, with an ex-Edelweiss CEO behind it), listed NCDs, an ICRA rating under review and managed gearing at 3.9x all create a hard quarterly reporting load — branch-level AUM, LTV, auction and NPA cuts. ICRA separately flagged that Keertana must keep augmenting IT systems, which usually surfaces first as analyst headcount around the LOS/LMS rather than as posted engineering roles. Best-matched role on this list for an engineering graduate, and HO-based rather than field.

estimated_roles.title: Talent Acquisition Executive – Branch Hiring
estimated_roles.family: HR / recruitment
estimated_roles.why: 171 branches at 4-8 staff each is roughly 800-1,200 hires inside 12 months, across tier-3 towns in four states. Headcount already moved 3,218 to 3,041 as the JLG book wound down, so this is net new sourcing, not backfill. Volume recruitment cells get staffed with freshers on a requisition-closure incentive.

estimated_roles.title: Branch Credit Officer – Affordable Housing & LAP
estimated_roles.family: Credit and underwriting
estimated_roles.why: Housing and loan-against-property are the non-gold verticals and are the ones that actually require file-level underwriting — income assessment for self-employed borrowers, title and valuation review. Smaller headcount than gold, and the round is gold-weighted, so this is a secondary need rather than a core one.

estimated_roles.title: Management Trainee / Officer Trainee – Branch Operations (Gold)
estimated_roles.family: Management trainee
estimated_roles.why: Opening 171 branches means needing ~171 branch managers, and the nine posted roles are already heavy on Cluster/Regional/Zonal Manager seats — the pipeline below them has to come from somewhere. NBFCs at this growth rate commonly stand up a 6-12 month officer-trainee cadre that rotates through sourcing, appraisal and ops before a branch posting. Not currently posted, which is why this is only possible.

estimated_roles.title: Collections / Recovery Officer
estimated_roles.family: Collections
estimated_roles.why: Two drivers: the JLG/microfinance book is being wound down and residual recovery needs feet on the ground, and a gold book growing this fast will throw off a rising auction and overdue pipeline that the branch sales staff cannot also chase. Typically a low-fixed, high-incentive structure and among the least desirable entry seats.

companies.fit_reason: Accessible but badly matched — those are two separate findings and both are real. On accessibility: this company will hire hundreds of 0-1 year people over the next 12 months, because 171 work-in-progress gold branches cannot open without them, and Loan Officer and Operations Executive are genuine no-experience-required rungs. A 2026/27 graduate who applies will get looked at. On match: six of the nine posted roles (Cluster Manager, Operations Manager, Regional Manager, Zonal Manager, Team Lead Sales, Insurance Manager) are 3-15 year branch-banking seats a fresher cannot reach, so the real fresher surface is two or three titles. Those titles are field jobs in tier-3 towns across AP, Telangana, Karnataka and Odisha — Dharmavaram, Adoni, Kavali, Podili, Nizamabad — not Hyderabad HO, and they effectively require Telugu or Kannada. They pay ₹2-3.5L against roughly ₹3.5-4.5L for a mass IT-services offer, with a large slice contingent on disbursement targets and no equity to compensate. And the profile's most telling detail is the absence: zero engineering roles posted despite ICRA explicitly flagging that Keertana must keep augmenting its IT systems, which means an engineering degree buys essentially no premium here and no technical career track. Worth applying to if the candidate wants NBFC branch-lending experience, is regionally rooted, and values a fast-scaling lender where branch managers get made early — a strong Loan Officer can be running a branch in 24-36 months in a network growing this fast. Not worth it as a default fallback offer for someone with an IT-services or GCC option open.
companies.caveat: Four honest reasons this could be wrong. First, the careers page is not a job board — it is an application form with a "Position Applying" dropdown, so those nine entries are the options the form accepts, not nine dated live requisitions. Some may be evergreen and some stale; treat none of them as a confirmed open mandate without calling HO. Second, no benchmark row in the file covers gold-loan NBFC branch roles. Every band here is transposed from adjacent field-sales, warehouse-ops and bank-MT populations, and the closest true comparables — Muthoot Finance and Manappuram junior relationship executives in the same AP/Telangana geography — are not in the dataset and were not fetched in this session, so the field bands rest on inference rather than on matched observations. Third, the stage bucket is genuinely ambiguous and the two candidate rows disagree by roughly 2x at the top: the profile itself flags that "Series B" is a database label and that the company should be paid as a mid-size BFSI employer, which means the honest answer sits between the Series C+ and listed/large rows rather than on either. I leaned toward the branch-network reading, and if Keertana instead pays like a funded growth-stage lender competing for talent, the HO bands in particular are 20-30% low. Fourth, and most likely to invalidate the predicted roles specifically: high-volume NBFC branch hiring in tier-3 towns overwhelmingly runs through walk-in drives, regional consultants and employee referrals that never touch the corporate careers page. The four predicted roles may exist as real needs and still never appear as a postable fresher requisition — and conversely, the fresher intake for the 171 new branches may already be flowing entirely through channels this analysis cannot see.

estimated_roles.title: Intern — Junior Carbon & GHG Modeler
estimated_roles.family: Analyst / graduate-entry technical-business
estimated_roles.why: The single best-matched live opening for a 2026/27 engineering graduate: quantitative GHG and carbon modelling work, no software-engineering requirement, and it sits directly on the MRV/science capability the Series B is funding. Realistic conversion path into 'Carbon and GHG modeler' or 'Senior Carbon Modeler'.

estimated_roles.title: Intern at Varaha
estimated_roles.family: Management trainee / graduate programme (generic)
estimated_roles.why: Varaha's generic intern requisition is the de-facto graduate door — there is no campus MT programme, so freshers enter through this and convert into associate seats in carbon projects, growth or finance. Stipend-based; the band is the annualised stipend at the low end and a realistic conversion CTC at the high end.

estimated_roles.title: Research Associate
estimated_roles.family: Business / research analyst
estimated_roles.why: Entry-level scientific-analytical seat supporting carbon methodology and MRV work — the moat the round is funding. Reachable by an engineering graduate with data/remote-sensing/environmental exposure, though agronomy, environmental science and GIS backgrounds are preferred over generalist engineering.

estimated_roles.title: Associate / Senior Associate - Growth
estimated_roles.family: Growth / commercial associate
estimated_roles.why: Explicitly an associate-level commercial seat; the Associate half of the title is open to a strong 0-1 year hire. Ties to the round's commercial build-out alongside the Head of RevOps, Sales Director and VP/Head of Marketing searches. Expect the Senior Associate half to go to 2-4 years.

estimated_roles.title: Associate - Finance
estimated_roles.family: Finance / business analyst
estimated_roles.why: Carbon-credit revenue recognition, project finance tracking against the ~$35M project debt, and grant/offtake reporting create real junior finance headcount — they are simultaneously hiring a Financial Controller, Project Finance Manager and Assistant Manager Business Finance. Caution: this track and the parallel 'CA-Fresher' req are written for CA/commerce backgrounds, so an engineering graduate is a second-choice candidate here.

estimated_roles.title: Field Investigator- Operations (Andhra Pradesh & Telangana)
estimated_roles.family: Field operations
estimated_roles.why: Ground-truthing farm data and audit sampling for carbon projects — genuine entry-level work with no experience bar, and Varaha hires these in volume district by district. Priced far below the metro ops benchmark because it is field-execution work in tier-2/3 districts, frequently on contract, not a Gurugram HQ analyst seat.

estimated_roles.title: Field Surveyor (Hisar, Sirsa, Fatehabad, Jind, Kaithal)
estimated_roles.family: Field operations (contract)
estimated_roles.why: Included to show the real floor of this employer: five near-identical Field Surveyor postings are cloned district-wise across Haryana and Punjab and are the largest volume of open roles. Contractual, vehicle-and-village work, and not a graduate business track — an engineering graduate would use it only as a stopgap or a route into an Area Supervisor seat.

estimated_roles.title: Carbon Project Operations Associate (MRV)
estimated_roles.family: Operations / programme management
estimated_roles.why: The round funds expansion into Vietnam and Indonesia while deepening India, Bangladesh and Nepal, and every new geography needs junior coordinators running sampling plans, farmer enrolment data and verification submissions under the existing Project Manager — Regenerative Agriculture and Senior Carbon Project Developer seats. This is the most predictable next fresher requisition.

estimated_roles.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
estimated_roles.family: Business / data analyst
estimated_roles.why: They are hiring a Head of RevOps and a Sales Director now; a first RevOps leader at Series B almost always requisitions one junior analyst within two quarters to own CRM hygiene, credit-pipeline reporting and offtake tracking against Microsoft/Google contracts. Strong fit for an engineering graduate with SQL and spreadsheet skill.

estimated_roles.title: Marketing Associate (Content / Communications)
estimated_roles.family: Growth and performance marketing
estimated_roles.why: A VP/Head of Marketing hire at this stage builds a small team beneath them, and a carbon developer selling to corporate buyers needs constant credit-methodology explainers, buyer collateral and impact reporting. Content-heavy rather than paid-performance, which is why the band sits in the lower half of the growth-marketing row.

estimated_roles.title: Partnerships Associate — Industrial Partners Program (VIPP)
estimated_roles.family: Business development / partnerships
estimated_roles.why: VIPP is named in the round's use of funds: recruit industrial operators with gasification capacity and sustainable biomass, then run them through Varaha's MRV. That is a repeatable outbound-and-onboarding motion, which is exactly the shape of work a fresher partnerships or BD associate gets. Priced below the SaaS-flavoured BD row because the counterparty is an industrial plant operator, not a software buyer.

estimated_roles.title: Associate, Founder's Office / Strategy
estimated_roles.family: Founder's office / chief of staff
estimated_roles.why: They have a senior 'Chief of Staff, Commercial' open; companies that create that seat at Series B commonly pair it with a junior analyst for market-entry diligence on Vietnam and Indonesia and board reporting. Highest-paying realistic fresher seat here, but the least certain — it may never be posted, and if posted will favour tier-1 campus and consulting profiles.

companies.fit_reason: There are real doors, but they are narrow and the volume hiring is not for graduates. On the positive side: two live internships (Junior Carbon & GHG Modeler, Carbon Standards & Methodology), a Research Associate seat, an explicitly associate-level Growth role, a CA-Fresher req and a generic "Intern at Varaha" — so this employer does hire at zero experience, which many Series B companies do not. Against that: of 44 live postings, the large majority are either senior functional leadership (Financial Controller, Head of HR, Head of RevOps, VP/Head of Marketing, Sales Director, State Heads, Technical Solutions Leads) or district-level field and telecalling work at 2-4 LPA, much of it contractual. There is no campus programme, no management-trainee track and no structured graduate intake, so a fresher enters opportunistically through an internship or an associate req rather than through a pipeline. The specific mismatch for an engineering graduate is background: the accessible non-engineering seats are carbon science, agronomy, methodology and finance, which favour environmental science, agriculture, geography/GIS and CA/commerce degrees. An engineering graduate competes well only where the work is quantitative modelling, data or operations analytics — which is why the modeler internship and a predicted RevOps analyst seat are the strongest matches, and the finance and field roles are the weakest.
companies.caveat: These are benchmark-derived estimates. Varaha has published no salary band for any of these roles, and nothing here comes from an offer letter or the company. Specific weaknesses to hold in mind: (1) the two field-role bands and the internship bands are extrapolated below or outside any benchmark row and are effectively low-confidence — treat them as order-of-magnitude only; (2) the underlying benchmark rows for operations and for non-metro locations are themselves marked low confidence and are bimodal, so an actual offer can land anywhere across a very wide range depending on whether the seat is HQ-analytical or field-execution; (3) no benchmark family covers carbon markets, MRV or climate science, so every science-adjacent band here is a mapping judgement onto the business-analyst row, not a measured rate; (4) six of the twelve roles are predictions, not postings — they may never be opened, and the "possible" ones especially; (5) the round record itself is imperfect — the 191 Cr / 2026-08-14 entry looks like an ROC filing date for a tranche of the February 2026 $45M WestBridge Series B rather than a separate August close, so hiring budget may be spread differently than a fresh-raise reading would suggest; (6) titles for listed roles are reproduced exactly as the ATS returns them, including irregular spacing and casing, and several Field Surveyor postings appear to be clones of one template rather than distinct openings.

estimated_roles.title: Relationship Manager - IFA / Partner Channel
estimated_roles.family: Field sales / business development (distribution partner acquisition)
estimated_roles.why: This is the engine of the business: One Digital is a B2B2C platform whose customers are IFAs, MFDs and independent wealth managers, and the round explicitly funds expanding that partner distribution platform. The profile traced a now-dead 'Relationship Manager - IFA channel' posting in Pune, and a 75-branch, 66-city footprint cannot run without continuous RM hiring. Highest-volume business-track seat at the company by a wide margin, and the one most likely to be open in any given month.

estimated_roles.title: Business / Product Analyst - One Digital platform
estimated_roles.family: Business analyst / product analyst
estimated_roles.why: The single clearest tie to what the round funds: strengthening the proprietary tech stack and roughly doubling the tech team. A platform transacting mutual funds, PMS, AIF, bonds, FDs and LAMF across thousands of partners generates transaction-funnel, partner-activation and RTA-reconciliation analysis that engineers do not own. Instahyre already shows Director of Engineering, AI Lead and Full Stack roles at Gurugram HQ - product/BA seats normally get added alongside that build-out. Best genuine fit for a 2026/27 engineering graduate, but a small number of HQ seats, not a volume intake.

estimated_roles.title: Client Onboarding & Transaction Operations Executive
estimated_roles.family: Operations (financial services back office)
estimated_roles.why: Every account opened across MF, PMS, AIF, bond and FD rails needs KYC, CAN/RTA setup, order punching, reconciliation and exception handling, and NRI/Global Private Client onboarding adds FATCA/FEMA paperwork. At Rs 15,000 Cr AUM growing fast, ops headcount scales with transaction volume regardless of hiring freezes elsewhere. Freshers are routinely taken here because the work is process-heavy and trainable.

estimated_roles.title: Wealth Manager (Associate / Trainee - Invictus Private Wealth)
estimated_roles.family: Private wealth sales / client advisory
estimated_roles.why: Centricity runs its own HNI/UHNW desks (Invictus and the NRI/Global Private Client arm) and the round funds accelerating both. The profile traced an expired LinkedIn 'Wealth Manager' posting in Ludhiana. Marked only 'possible' for a fresher: private-wealth desks overwhelmingly hire experienced RMs who bring an existing client book, and NISM/AMFI certification plus a CFP/MBA-finance background is the usual filter. An engineering graduate would enter through a trainee/associate variant if one exists at all.

estimated_roles.title: Founder's Office / Strategy Associate
estimated_roles.family: Founder's office / chief of staff / strategy
estimated_roles.why: Standard post-round hire: a Rs 280 Cr raise with SMBC as lead brings investor reporting, board packs, international/NRI market entry work and M&A or partnership diligence. Founder Manu Awasthy is running a 75-branch expansion plus an international push, which is exactly the workload that creates this seat. Possible rather than likely because it is a one- or two-person function and often filled by referral rather than posting.

estimated_roles.title: Growth & Partner Marketing Associate
estimated_roles.family: Growth and performance marketing
estimated_roles.why: Partner acquisition for One Digital is a funnel problem - IFA lead-gen campaigns, webinar and event programmes, content for the distributor community, and app-activation nudges. The round funds B2B2C platform expansion, which usually carries a small marketing build. Possible only: financial-distribution firms of this shape often run acquisition through the branch RM network and keep marketing thin.

companies.fit_reason: Mixed, and the split matters more than the average. The bad half: the business-track hiring this company must be doing at 75 branches is overwhelmingly field RM and branch-operations work - target-carrying distribution sales at Rs 3-5.5L fixed, high churn, usually filtered on NISM/AMFI certification and a finance or MBA background rather than a B.Tech. An engineering graduate can get these seats but is competing on someone else's home ground for pay well below what the same graduate would clear in a software role. The private-wealth desks (Invictus, NRI/GPC) are effectively closed to freshers - those hires bring an existing client book. The good half: the round funds the tech stack and the One Digital platform explicitly, and roughly doubling the tech team is the kind of build-out that pulls business/product analyst seats along with it - that is a genuine fit for an engineering graduate and the only band here that clears Rs 10L. But it is a handful of HQ seats in Gurugram, not a graduate intake programme. Not 'good', because the well-paid fit is narrow and unposted; not 'poor', because unlike an NBFC branch network or a manufacturer this company does have a real product organisation a graduate can enter.
companies.caveat:
Estimates from benchmark rows. Centricity has published no salary band, and nothing here is an offer or a quote.

Nothing is marked 'listed now'. The careers page loads but enumerates zero roles - its only 'View Open Positions' button links out to linkedin.com/company/centricity-wealthtech/jobs, which is behind a login wall, and work@centricity.com is given as the fallback. Every business-track posting the research traced is dead (LinkedIn 'Wealth Manager', Ludhiana, now 301s to the expired-job page; 'Relationship Manager - IFA channel', Pune, on HiringGo, no longer renders). The only live listings anywhere are engineering (Cutshort: .Net Core Developer, Gurugram, Rs 8-15L; Instahyre: Director of Engineering, AI Lead Developer, AI Lead, Full Stack Developer, DevOps Engineer, Mobile Application Manager). So all six roles above are predictions, and the two dead postings are evidence of a recurring pattern, not of a current opening. The researcher's WebSearch budget was exhausted before the last targeted non-engineering queries ran - the absence of business roles is 'not findable through the channels reachable from here', not proof none are open. Anyone with a LinkedIn account should open the company jobs page directly before acting on this.

Confidence is 'low' rather than the source rows' 'medium' for two reasons: the stage is genuinely ambiguous (a 'Series A' label on a company with Rs 933 Cr revenue and 500-900 staff - the Series A-B rows may under-price the HQ seats and the Series C+ rows would over-price the branch seats), and there is no observable compensation data for this specific employer to calibrate against. Also note a data error in the source row: it records the round as 257Cr, but every published source reports Rs 280 Cr (~Rs 230 Cr equity + ~Rs 50 Cr venture debt / US$29.4M). Rs 280 Cr is the real figure; 257Cr appears to be a currency-conversion artifact in the funding database.

estimated_roles.title: Academic Operations Associate (tutor supply and class quality)

companies.fit_reason:
The sector fits, the specific company barely has room. Consumer edtech is one of the few Indian sectors that genuinely hires 0-1 year engineering graduates into business roles at volume — none of the six roles above needs prior domain experience, and academic ops, counselling and retention are all learnable in a month. That is the good half.

The mixed half is this company's size and surface. It is 11-50 people (realistically 20-40 core staff), it has no careers page at all — khareclasses.com/careers soft-404s to the homepage, the 179-URL sitemap contains no jobs or about page, and the LinkedIn Jobs tab is empty — and it has zero listed openings, so nothing here is "listed now". A company this size opens a handful of business seats a year and fills most of them through founder networks and referrals, not applications. The Rs 199/month ARPU also caps every band in the Rs 3-6 L region, which is below what the same graduate would get from a Series B startup in Pune.

One thing that looks like a fit but is not: they recruit IITian tutors continuously, and an engineering graduate is an obvious candidate. That is near-certainly their highest-volume open role right now — but it is per-class or contract work, not a salaried business track, no benchmark row covers it, and it does not build a business career. Do not count it as one of these roles. The realistic route into an actual business seat here is a direct approach to the founders or the support line, not a job board.

Company identity itself is solid despite the common-sounding name (India Quotient's portfolio page, the live product and the LinkedIn page independently agree on the three founders and the 2022 founding year) — this is not an offline coaching institute of the same name. companies.fit_reason: Hiring is real, current and local — 13 Gurgaon roles posted at once about two weeks ago — and two of them (Founders Office – Operations, Warehouse Ops Executive) are genuine 0-1 yr entry points, with an organic-social and an influencer seat plausibly reachable for a strong fresher. That is why this is not 'poor'. It is not 'good' either, for four reasons. First, the shape of the hiring is senior, not junior: Finance Controller, Performance Marketing Lead, Creative Content Director/Head, Senior Manager R&D, Senior/Executive HR — a company building its first layer of function owners, not a company running a graduate intake. There is no management-trainee programme, no campus process, and no careers page at all (scrubsy.co.in/pages/careers 404s); everything runs through LinkedIn, so a fresher is applying into the same pool as experienced candidates with no fresher-specific track. Second, the team is small — inferred 30-60 people with no source behind that number — which means little structured onboarding and no one whose job is to train a graduate. Third, the pay is FMCG/D2C scale, not the SaaS or fintech scale an engineering graduate is usually benchmarking against: the realistic offers here are ₹3-8L, and the warehouse role is ₹2.5-4.5L. Fourth, the engineering-degree fit is oblique — nothing on the list is software (the one Shopify Developer posting aside), and the technical role that does exist (R&D) is formulation chemistry, so a CS/IT graduate would be taking a business-operations job, not an adjacent one. Worth applying to the Founders Office role specifically; treat the rest as opportunistic.
companies.caveat: These are benchmark-derived estimates. Scrubsy has published no salary band for any role, and nothing here comes from an offer, an employee report or the company. Specific weaknesses to carry forward: (1) Band confidence is 'low' — the underlying benchmark rows for this stage/city are themselves rated low-to-medium and are largely extrapolated from stage-discount language rather than observed seed-stage offers, and I lowered a step further because the company is tiny and roughly a year old. Real offers at a company this size vary more than any band; a single founder's preference moves a number by ₹2L. (2) The 'listed now' titles come from live LinkedIn job listings, not a company careers page — that source is weaker, and LinkedIn does not reliably retire filled roles, so some of these four may already be closed. Titles are reproduced exactly as the profile recorded them. (3) Headcount (~30-60) is an inference with no source behind it; if the team is actually under 20, drop every band another 10-15% and treat the predicted roles as materially less likely. (4) Four of the eight roles are predictions tied to the round's stated use of funds (category expansion into car care and laundry) — they are reasoned, not posted, and may never open. (5) I excluded the live 'Executive Assistant to CEO' posting: it is entry-level but an administrative track, not a business track an engineering graduate would be hired into, and pricing it against these benchmark families would mislead. 'Performance Marketing Lead', 'Creative Content Director/Head/Lead', 'Finance Controller' and 'Senior Manager/Manager – R&D' were excluded as out of reach at 0-1 years. (6) The company profile itself notes its web-search budget was exhausted, so the roles list and funding detail rest on direct page fetches; additional coverage may exist that neither of us saw.

companies.fit_reason: Mixed, and closer to poor than the role count suggests. The company will hire freshers - affordable HFCs staff branch expansion with graduates of any discipline - but not into the kind of work a 2026/27 engineering graduate is training for, and not at engineering-graduate pay. Three specifics. (1) All six live openings are experienced BFSI seats: Sr. Manager - CRM, Area Credit Manager, Branch Business Head, Branch Credit Manager are 3-10 year roles, and even the Relationship Manager post asks for 10 years. There is no graduate programme, no campus track and no advertised trainee cadre. (2) There are zero engineering roles on the careers page, and that is structural, not a snapshot - the company publicised an Oracle Cloud migration in 2024, so it buys its stack rather than building it. An engineering graduate here is a business hire whose degree is irrelevant to the job. (3) The realistic entry points - field sourcing, collections, branch operations - are Rs 2.2-4.0 LPA, field-based in tier-2/3 towns across seven states, with transfer risk and high churn. That is roughly half to a third of what the same graduate would get from a tier-2 IT services or product company. The one genuinely good fit is the head-office MIS/Business Analyst seat in Chennai at Rs 3.5-6.0 LPA, where SQL and reporting skills actually pay - but a 262-person lender may run that function with two or three experienced people and never post it. Anyone applying should target the Chennai head-office analytics/credit seats and treat the branch roles as a fallback, not a plan.
companies.caveat: Estimates from benchmark extrapolation. Unico Housing Finance has not published a salary band for any role, and neither has any close peer. Four compounding uncertainties. (1) ROUND UNVERIFIED: the export row priced here - Series B, Rs 55 Cr, 2026-08-13, Anicut Capital[+1] - has no public corroboration; the only reported raise is Rs 120 Cr from Anicut Capital and UC Impower (Sept 2025), and the export row looks like a garbled or restated version of that deal. Do not quote the Rs 55 Cr / Aug 2026 figure. Stage placement for pricing is therefore my judgement, not a confirmed fact. (2) EVERY BENCHMARK ROW I USED IS ITSELF MARKED "low" CONFIDENCE, and each note says explicitly that the Series A-B / non-metro cell is extrapolated rather than observed. (3) SECTOR MISMATCH: the rows are built from SaaS, quick-commerce and funded-startup comparables; an NBFC-HFC branch network is a different labour market, so my 35-45 percent haircut is a reasoned adjustment, not a measured one. (4) SIX OF EIGHT ROLES ARE PREDICTED, not posted - only Relationship Manager and Recruiter - HR are live titles, and the listings carry no posting dates, so "open" means present on the live page as of 2026-09-10. Headcount is also unsettled: ~262 on trackers, but 86 branches across 7 states implies a true payroll in the high hundreds to low thousands, which is why I treated this as a branch-banking employer rather than a 262-person startup. Confidence lowered one step from the source rows for the unconfirmed round and the sector mismatch.

companies.fit_reason: Split verdict, and the split matters more than the average. Against the fresher: every single publicly visible opening is experienced frontline secured-lending sales - two builder-channel home-loan RM posts and a walk-in LAP Sales Manager - and NBFC channel sales screens for existing DSA and builder relationships that a 2026/2027 graduate does not have. The 'Sales Manager' title in particular is a 1-3 year role. The group careers page at jfs.in/careers carries no individual vacancies at all, only a resume inbox, which is what a company with no structured campus intake looks like from the outside. And an engineering degree is close to irrelevant in these roles; commerce graduates and MBAs are the default hire. For the fresher: this is a genuinely fast-scaling lender, not a mature bank protecting headcount - AUM up 163% and disbursements up 173% in a year, JFSL group headcount from ~584 in FY24 to over 2,000 in FY26. Growth of that shape always creates volume entry seats in credit operations, underwriting support and collections, and the BofA mandate to import risk management, governance and technology capability points at a deliberate build-out of risk and portfolio analytics, which is where an engineering graduate's SQL and Python are actually worth paying for. The practical conclusion: do not expect to walk into a business-track seat here through a public job board. The realistic routes are the careers@jfs.in inbox, staffing agencies that supply NBFC credit ops, and Reliance/Jio group campus channels - and the sales roles that are visible pay bottom-quartile fixed cash with a target-contingent tail.
companies.caveat: The visible hiring sample is three postings from two Naukri recruiter accounts, and none of them is entry-level - so the role mix above is built mostly on inference about what a lender tripling its book must need, not on observed vacancies. A group this size hires through internal referral and staffing agencies, so the true opening list is near-certainly larger and differently shaped than what I could see; there may already be a Jio Credit or JFSL graduate cadre recruiting off campus that leaves no public trace, in which case both the titles and the pay grid would be standardised and could differ materially from these bands in either direction. The bands themselves are the second weakness: none of these companies published a band, and no benchmark row is specific to NBFC secured lending. I priced the sales roles by an analogy - Indian listed internet BDE/inside-sales - drawn from IndiaMART, Info Edge and edtech BDA data, which may not travel cleanly to mortgage channel sales, where fixed pay can run lower and the incentive tail higher than I have assumed. Finally, the stage label in the source export was wrong ('Series D' venture funding for what is a JV preferential allotment by a listed large-cap subsidiary); I have corrected it to listed/large, but if the group prices this entity as a growth venture rather than as Reliance-grid corporate BFSI, the analytical roles could pay above these bands. That correction, plus the absence of any NBFC-specific benchmark row and any posted band, is why confidence is medium despite the underlying benchmark rows being rated high.

A junior account-farming seat handling renewals, oil-analysis reporting and escalation is a natural post-round addition; pays above pure inside sales because it is customer-facing to large accounts.

estimated_roles.title: MIS / Data Analyst - Fluid Analytics
estimated_roles.family: Business analyst / data analyst
estimated_roles.why: The round funds 'fleet automation and fluid analytics'. Someone junior has to turn oil-sample results, machine telemetry and job data into customer reports and internal utilisation dashboards. Highest band in this list because Excel/SQL/Power BI skills price above generalist sales-support work even at an SME, and an engineering graduate is a credible hire here.

estimated_roles.title: Marketing Executive (Digital / Content)
estimated_roles.family: Growth and performance marketing
estimated_roles.why: They have advertised a Marketing Head (4-9 yrs) and a Senior Graphic Designer (1-3 yrs); a head plus a designer usually implies a junior executive underneath to run LinkedIn, trade-show collateral, case studies and inbound lead capture. Industrial B2B marketing pays below consumer/D2C performance marketing, so this sits at the bottom half of the marketing row.

companies.fit_reason: They genuinely do hire freshers into business roles — the two WorkIndia listings loaded today say "graduate/fresher" in as many words, so unlike many industrial SMEs this is not a closed door. But the pay is the problem, not the access: ₹15,000-21,000/month is roughly ₹1.8-2.5 LPA, below the benchmark floor for almost every entry-level business family in India, and there is no structured management-trainee or graduate programme to compensate. For a 2026/27 B.E. graduate specifically, the honest read is that the better door at this company is the technical one — a mechanical, chemical, electrical or instrumentation graduate is a far stronger candidate for the field-service engineer, applications engineer and R&D roles the ₹30 Cr round is actually funding (miniaturised fluid treatment, fleet automation, re-refining), and those roles are simply not visible on any public board yet. The business track here is a fine entry point for domain learning in industrial B2B and lubrication/circularity, and the customer list is genuinely blue-chip experience, but a graduate optimising for first-year cash should treat these bands as a floor to negotiate off, not a target.
companies.careers_url: https://www.minimacsystems.com/careers (serves the homepage; the only real hiring link is https://www.linkedin.com/company/minimacsystemsprivatetlimited/jobs/, which showed zero live postings when checked)
companies.caveat: The careers data underneath this is thin and partly stale, which is the biggest single risk. Only the three WorkIndia sales listings were actually loaded and read today; the HR Generalist, Accounts Executive, Sr. Project Management Officer, Marketing Head and Senior Graphic Designer entries come from captcha-blocked Naukri/Jobaaj/Glassdoor pages read as search-index snippets, with posting dates spanning Nov 2025 to Apr 2026 — several may be closed. Minimac has no functioning careers page and its LinkedIn jobs tab was empty, so there is no clean same-day snapshot to check against. Second risk: the ₹30 Cr round closed only four weeks ago (2026-08-12) and every observed salary point predates it or barely postdates it, so if the company resets its pay structure to compete for regional-hub and R&D talent, the sales bands here could be 30-50% low within a year — my bands describe the Minimac that existed before the money landed. Third: the stage label is genuinely ambiguous and the benchmark rows I used are the weakest in the file (every seed x non-metro row is self-flagged "low confidence" and extrapolated rather than measured), so the row itself may be wrong in the same direction I am. Finally, all ten roles are inferred to be non-engineering, which is itself odd for a company whose round funds R&D — if Minimac's actual post-round hiring turns out to be overwhelmingly technical, the business-track list here will look larger than reality.

estimated_roles.title: Founder's Office / Business Associate
estimated_roles.family: Founder's office / chief of staff / strategy associate (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)
estimated_roles.why: The single non-engineering hire a pre-seed deep-tech spinout actually makes: one generalist next to the CEO (Sanyam Parashar is the only non-PhD founder) covering investor reporting to Artha and Finvolve, incorporation/compliance admin, IITM Research Park logistics, recruiting coordination and deck work. Nothing in the round is earmarked for it, so it happens only if the CEO decides he cannot scale himself.

estimated_roles.title: Business Development Associate - Defence & Space (technical pre-sales)
estimated_roles.family: Business development, inside sales and account management (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)
estimated_roles.why: The product is sold to DRDO/iDEX, ISRO/IN-SPACe and drone-platform OEMs, which is a relationship-and-credentials sale on multi-year cycles. A fresher here would be support, not owner: qualifying inbound, tender and RFP tracking on iDEX/GeM, and translating compression ratios and link-budget numbers for buyers. Most likely to exist only after the core library is demo-ready.

estimated_roles.title: Grants, Proposals & Programme Associate
estimated_roles.family: Management trainee / graduate leadership / business associate (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)
estimated_roles.why: The clearest real need created by the funding itself: they are running a Rs 1.5 Cr National Quantum Mission grant alongside the equity, and the obvious next money is more non-dilutive - iDEX SPRINT/ADITI, TDF, MeitY and further NQM tranches. Someone has to write, submit and report on those. Usually absorbed by a founder, occasionally handed to a junior hire.

estimated_roles.title: Marketing & Communications Associate
estimated_roles.family: Growth and performance marketing (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)
estimated_roles.why: Their public surface is an unmodified Webflow template with Lorem ipsum still on the contact page and a dead #careers anchor, so the gap is visible. But B2G/defence deep-tech does not run performance marketing - the need is a working site, a capability one-pager and conference presence. Realistically an internship or contract engagement, not a salaried fresher role.

companies.fit_reason: This is a professor-founded IIT Madras deep-tech spinout of roughly eight people, of whom four are PhDs and one is the CEO, on Rs 2 Cr of equity plus a Rs 1.5 Cr research grant, pre-revenue, still building the core compression library. There is no business function to join yet. Every rupee in the round is pointed at algorithm work - the money buys research engineers who can do tensor-network and compression work, not business hires, and at this burn the entire equity round supports roughly 8-12 person-years total. The customer set makes it worse for a fresher: defence and space buyers are reached through DRDO/iDEX/ISRO relationships, prior clearances and IIT Madras networks, none of which a 2026 graduate carries, and a pre-seed team cannot afford to train someone into that. There is also no hiring surface at all - no careers page, a dead #careers anchor, /careers and /jobs both 404, an empty LinkedIn jobs tab - which is consistent with a company that hires through founder outreach and IITM Research Park referrals rather than posted requisitions. The honest read: a strong engineering fresher with signal-processing, compression or quantum-algorithms coursework has a real shot at a research/engineering role here; a business-track fresher most likely has zero openings for the next 9-18 months, and the realistic route in is an internship or a project through the IITM ecosystem rather than a salaried business role. Anyone who does land one should expect a generalist job with no manager, no process and below-market cash.
companies.careers_url: No careers page exists. Footer link https://www.quarkitech.com/#careers is a dead anchor (the "careers" strings in the homepage HTML are unused Webflow template class names), and /careers, /careers.html and /jobs all return 404. Closest live surface: https://www.linkedin.com/company/quarkitech (no jobs listed). Better watch targets: founders' personal LinkedIn posts (Sanyam Parashar, Dr Shashikant Singh Kunwar) and the IITM Incubation Cell / Research Park listings.
companies.caveat: The honest reason this could be wrong: not one of these four roles is evidenced. The profile is unverified because there is no careers page to verify against, the currently_open list is genuinely empty, and no reporting on the round (Entrackr, Indian Startup News, FinSMES, Analytics Insight) mentions hiring plans, headcount targets or any role. Every title here is inferred from what an eight-person pre-revenue defence/space deep-tech company plausibly needs, and the most likely single outcome is that Quarkitech opens zero business-track entry-level roles in the next year and spends the round entirely on research engineers. The bands carry two stacked uncertainties: the benchmark rows for "seed/pre-Series A" plus "other Indian city" are themselves marked low confidence in the source file (extrapolated from stage-discount language, not from observed offers), and I then applied a further judgement-based pre-seed haircut on top. A specific way the numbers could break upward: IIT Madras Research Park and National Quantum Mission companies sometimes pay at or above the seed band to compete for talent inside the campus ecosystem, and government grant budgets can fund a named project-associate line at a fixed, better-than-startup rate - so a "Project Associate" style offer at Rs 5-7L is possible even though I have priced the generic business roles below that. A way it could break downward: the first non-engineering person hired at a company this size is frequently an intern converted at Rs 2.5-3.5L, or a co-founder-level equity-only arrangement with no meaningful cash at all. Finally, the tracker's own row is wrong on three counts (stage labelled Seed rather than pre-seed, investor labelled Artha India Ventures rather than Artha Access/Artha Venture Fund II, and it drops both Finvolve and the Rs 1.5 Cr grant), so if the downstream pipeline re-reads that row rather than this analysis it will benchmark this company one stage too high.

Character story cards and books mean an expanding SKU count, which is exactly what creates this seat.

That manager will need one or two junior hands, and this is the role where an engineering graduate's background is an actual advantage rather than a mismatch.

estimated_roles.title: Content & Social Media Associate
estimated_roles.family: Growth and performance marketing (content/social sub-band, below paid media)
